toegepas.blok: Vuil lug, vuil water en vuil grond
toegepas.voor: Rook uit voertuie en uit vullis wat brand maak die lug vuil.
toegepas.na: Rook uit voertuie en uit vullis wat brand, maak die lug vuil.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma closing the relative clause stops 'brand maak' being read together, and matches the lesson's own 'Rommel wat lê, trek' pattern.
toegepas.fout: 'wat brand maak' runs two verbs together so the relative clause is misread on a first pass
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma where the relative clause ends and the main verb begins makes the sentence read correctly, matches the lesson's own 'Rommel wat lê, trek' and leaves the meaning as it was.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Litter that is left lying about 'lê rond'; bare 'wat lê' sounds unfinished.
toegepas.fout: bare 'wat lê' for litter sounds unfinished
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Rommel wat rondlê' is the natural fixed way to say litter left lying about, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Uitbroei' means to hatch; mosquitoes breed ('broei') in standing water.
toegepas.fout: 'broei uit' means to hatch, which is not quite what adult mosquitoes do
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Muskiete broei in water' is the idiomatic phrase for mosquitoes breeding in standing water, and it keeps the point that standing water is where they multiply.

toegepas.voor: Die rook uit 'n groot fabriek is nie jou werk om reg te maak nie.
toegepas.na: Om die rook uit 'n groot fabriek reg te maak, is nie jou werk nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written the smoke itself is 'not your job'; fronting the infinitive makes the fixing the subject, at the cost of one word.
toegepas.fout: English calque ('the smoke is not your job to fix') that makes the smoke itself the job
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting the infinitive gives the natural Afrikaans structure with the same meaning; this is a framing sentence, not a safety instruction.

toegepas.voor: Wat jy self kan doen is klein maar dit maak
toegepas.na: Wat jy self kan doen, is klein, maar dit maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma closes the subject clause before 'is', and AWS requires one before 'maar' since 'dit maak' is a second clause with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'maar' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb, and the subject clause runs straight into 'is'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both commas are required or helpful under AWS 2017 and change no words.

toegepas.blok: Dinge wat jy elke dag kan doen
toegepas.voor: Maak kompos van skille en blare, en spaar
toegepas.na: Maak kompos van skille en blare en spaar
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two commands with no stated subject take no comma before 'en' under AWS 2017.
toegepas.fout: comma before 'en' joining two command halves with no stated subject
toegepas.rede_keurder: Under AWS 2017 command halves without their own subject take no comma before 'en'.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A named national observance takes no indefinite article.
toegepas.fout: indefinite article before a named national observance
toegepas.rede_keurder: A named observance takes no article in Afrikaans; the name itself is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Dit was eers net een dag en dit is later
toegepas.na: Dit was eers net een dag en is later
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written it needs an AWS comma before 'en'; dropping the repeated 'dit' gives one subject, so no comma is needed and the sentence is shorter.
toegepas.fout: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' without the AWS comma
toegepas.rede_keurder: Dropping the repeated 'dit' gives one subject, so no comma is needed, and the sentence is shorter with the same meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Skoolgrond' reads as the soil; the school's premises are 'die skoolterrein', and a tree is planted 'op' them.
toegepas.fout: 'in die skoolgrond' reads as the soil rather than the school's grounds
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Op die skoolterrein' is the plain natural phrase for school premises, and it describes the same event.

toegepas.voor: 'n Boom gooi skaduwee en dit bly
toegepas.na: 'n Boom gooi skaduwee, en dit bly
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb ('Boom gooi', 'dit bly') take a comma before 'en' under AWS 2017.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Boom gooi', 'dit bly')
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 requires the comma here, and no words change.

toegepas.rede_vinder: After a noun of time the relative is 'waarop', not 'wanneer'.
toegepas.fout: 'n dag wanneer' copies English 'a day when'; after a noun of time the relative is 'waarop'
toegepas.rede_keurder: This is a plain one-word grammar fix to the definition that leaves its meaning exactly as it was.

laat_vaar.blok: Vullis wat lê waar dit nie hoort nie
laat_vaar.voor: waar vullis beland waar dit nie hoort nie
laat_vaar.na: waar vullis beland wat nie daar hoort nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Avoids the clumsy 'waar ... waar' repetition without changing the meaning or the length.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Waar ... waar' is acceptable, and the restrictive 'vullis wat nie daar hoort nie' quietly suggests some litter does belong there; it also breaks the parallel with the heading and the glossary wording.

laat_vaar.blok: Vuil water kan 'n mens maagsiek maak
laat_vaar.voor: lyk soms skoon en is dit tog nie
laat_vaar.na: lyk soms skoon maar is dit tog nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The sentence is a contrast, so 'maar' is the natural joiner; no comma because the second half shares the subject.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'En is dit tog nie' is natural Afrikaans, since 'tog' already carries the contrast; swapping in 'maar' is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Dood staan' is not idiomatic Afrikaans; the verb is 'doodgaan' (see also the flag on this sentence).
na_skrywer.fout: the sentence is muddled: 'wat later dood staan' grammatically attaches to 'werk', not to the tree
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: 'Doodgaan' leaves the work rather than the tree dying and also loses the picture of a dead tree left standing, so the sentence needs the writer's fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Om ou goed te gebruik om iets nuuts van te maak.
na_skrywer.na: Om iets nuuts van ou goed te maak.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Removes the stranded 'van' and the double 'om ... om' with the same meaning, and is shorter.
na_skrywer.fout: stranded 'van' and double 'om ... om' in the definition
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The proposal rewords a glossary definition beyond a plain grammar fix and drops the idea of using old things, so the writer must fix it for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Die deel van die lug wat lewende dinge moet inasem.
vlae.rede: The protected entry for 'suurstof' says fish and most water animals use no air at all; a definition saying all living things must breathe in air may state that error. Content question, not a language one, so not changed.

vlae.teks: 'n Boom wat niemand natmaak nie, is 'n dag se werk wat later dood staan.
vlae.rede: Even with 'doodgaan' the sentence says a day's work dies; the intended point (the tree dies and the day's work is lost) cannot be rephrased cleanly without guessing the wording the writer wants, and the text is at its ceiling.
